//@version=5
indicator("EMA Ribbon Trend", shorttitle="Ribbon", overlay=true)
fast = input.int(8, "Fast EMA", minval=1)
mid  = input.int(21, "Mid EMA", minval=1)
slow = input.int(55, "Slow EMA", minval=1)
e1 = ta.ema(close, fast)
e2 = ta.ema(close, mid)
e3 = ta.ema(close, slow)
bull = e1 > e2 and e2 > e3
bear = e1 < e2 and e2 < e3
plot(e1, "Fast", color=color.new(color.teal, 0))
plot(e2, "Mid", color=color.new(color.blue, 0))
plot(e3, "Slow", color=color.new(color.orange, 0), linewidth=2)
bgcolor(bull ? color.new(color.teal, 90) : bear ? color.new(color.orange, 90) : na)
alertcondition(bull and not bull[1], "Ribbon turns bullish", "EMA ribbon aligned bullish")
alertcondition(bear and not bear[1], "Ribbon turns bearish", "EMA ribbon aligned bearish")
rule:
//@version=5
strategy("Rule B1: enter on bull flip, exit on bear flip, long only", overlay=true, initial_capital=10000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1)
fast = input.int(8, "Fast EMA")
mid  = input.int(21, "Mid EMA")
slow = input.int(55, "Slow EMA")
e1 = ta.ema(close, fast)
e2 = ta.ema(close, mid)
e3 = ta.ema(close, slow)
bull = e1 > e2 and e2 > e3
bear = e1 < e2 and e2 < e3
// signal on a closed bar, filled at the next bar's open (default strategy semantics)
if bull and not bull[1]
    strategy.entry("L", strategy.long)
if bear and not bear[1]
    strategy.close("L")
